items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I work with him. I work with him on San Charles Street but I forgot the name of the place. And so many different places I work with Antoine.

ctx.x: I started on the banjo but I put it down because guitars got popular and you know, in the, around the early 30s guitars got popular and I fell in love with the guitar and I just put the banjo down. Well I had a good start on the banjo. Oh. What about this drummer named Antoine? Did you ever know him? Oh yeah. You live in?
I don't know. I just wondered if you told me about him once.
